You see a fridge. You can make out a closed oven. You make out a table. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a table? On the table you make out a cookbook. You can make out a counter. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. You make out a stove. The stove appears to be empty.

There is a closed frosted-glass door leading east. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, there is no door.

There is a knife, a raw purple potato, a red onion and an orange bell pepper on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a diced roasted red potato, a chopped roasted block of cheese, a diced grilled pork chop, a sliced grilled red hot pepper and a chopped fried yellow bell pepper.

feedback:
Adding the meal to your inventory.
